0022600037.text: The Bulls, now 1-9 with a 0-4 home record, host the Hawks, who are 7-5 and first in the Southeast, in Chicago's 11th game of the season. Chicago is on an eight-game losing streak and sits 14th in the East and 4th in the Central, six games back, while Atlanta enters on a one-game losing streak and sits 4th in the East. Chicago is missing Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation), Dailyn Swain (back), and Tobe Awaka (back), and Caleb Wilson is day-to-day with a hand injury and a game-time decision, while Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Bulls won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 126-123 win in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
